title: They Don't Work In The Cold...
summary: Kyle Conner of Out of Spec Reviews finds that new Electrify America chargers co-developed with BTC fail in cold weather, then checks ChargePoint, EVgo and other EA stations during a cold snap.
why: Cited in EV threads as evidence that public fast-charging reliability suffers in cold temperatures.

quote.text: make sure your fast DC chargers actually work in the cold
